programme.desc: 小肠气的学名是疝气，常见于男性、长者与肥胖人士。外科医生指小肠气有机会影响肠道血液循环，严重时更可导致肠坏死。小肠气主要透过手术治疗，传统与微创手术各有甚么优点？旅行天文摄影爱好者畅谈缘何自小培养观星兴趣，并介绍观星的魅力。他提醒观星时要遵守的基本礼仪，如拍照切勿使用闪光灯。嘉宾推介大埔山区、离岛的观星热点，也会展示其星空摄影作品，分享深刻观星经历。「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie师傅示范「三黄蛋」。

programme.title: 意外现场粤
programme.desc: 有米新郎与拜金新娘有情人终成眷属，岂料结婚过程险象环生，喜庆现场变成意外现场。摄影师采用航拍技术拍摄婚照，却不擅操控令航拍机变成伤人武器，现时可有相关法例规管？在斑马线停留拍照会触犯交通条例，花车布置饰物更有可能令司机干犯不小心驾驶。婚宴开席前邀请宾客围坐「耍乐」，会否构成非法聚赌？兄弟团投入玩乐引致频频受伤，还幸有救伤队代表在场予以正确急救。新郎于宴席上心脏病发不幸离世，临终遗言竟酿成争产风波？

programme.title: 乘胜狙击#9粤PG
programme.desc: 冠一、柏义到天龙旧居，倾谈下一步行动。正花向冠一求证心中疑惑，冠一的态度俨如陌生人，正花伤心。骏升为月华准备了生日宴，再向她表白，月华表明仍挂念天龙。冠一、柏义遭人追杀，月华求骏升停止行动。柏义突然向曦昕提出分手，坦言自己是天龙之子，还被骏升追杀。曦昕找骏升对质，骏升对找到天龙之子感高兴，还邀请柏义加入娱乐城董事局。正花喝醉，在麻将桌上自揭出千，只求被人打死……

programme.title: 茶煲世家#50粤
programme.desc: 子敏受同学怂恿，利用买参考书的折扣差价买化妆品，丽娟和子东悉子敏不诚实而不悦。子东接到一男子找子敏的电话，恐他教坏子敏而详加盘问，子敏尴尬又不满。子敏同学不慎打烂人家的东西要照价赔偿，向子敏等求助，子敏向丽娟借零用，丽娟不肯。一天，丽娟从街坊口中得知子敏在快餐店兼职赚钱，担心女儿受骗，著子东兄弟到快餐店了解，竟见子敏被一肥仔带到后巷，子敏并给对方钱，二人见状即挟持肥仔，经解释后始知一场误会。

programme.title: 锦心似玉#2粤普
programme.desc: 十一娘与两位姐姐来徐家参加春日宴，席间，程国公府的乔莲房应元娘要求带众人去放纸鸢，二娘跟去；元娘带十一娘撞破徐令宜和莲房独处一室，元娘逼迫莲房嫁入徐府做妾，十一娘看穿元娘设局，猜出自己被挑中做继室。

programme.title: 区区开伙粤
programme.desc: 由谢霆锋提供构思的「黑蒜蓉包」是甚么味道？家燕姐带队到北角区探索。麦包、张美妮带林欣彤品尝该区的港式瑞士汁、马来西亚、潮州滋味。大王、李锦联精选素食馆，新派传统自助餐兼备，还少不免结伴扫街寻各路美食！

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
一路前行II粤普
programme.desc: 节目由胡歌、刘涛和陈龙携手中国国家地理融媒体中心主任张辰亮以及一众新朋友，在节目中带观众走进自然，走进科学研究员、环保爱好者和当地居民的生活工作。

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 巴基斯坦的木尔坦, 南亚最古老的城市。陪伴木尔坦人穿越沙漠的骆驼对他们来说是很珍贵的存在 死后的骆驼更被制作成骆驼皮灯，再画上传统的纳卡什图案，为木尔坦人照亮黑暗的尽头

programme.title: 排档寻情味粤英
programme.desc: 走进新加坡不同世代小贩的生活，感受他们之间的关爱、争吵以及他们对彼此坚定不移的支持。

programme.title: 西葡潮什么粤
programme.desc: 梁芷珮不忘观赏葡萄牙足球比赛，虽然置身作客场区，但于现场的炽热气氛下，仍可全情投入精彩比拼，High爆！除了睇波，紧记参观当地著名球队的博物馆，踏入球员通道、更衣室、历史专区，足球铁粉尽情打卡。芷珮到访沙甸鱼罐头工场，难得窥探国民美食的制作过程，她试制的手信又有多独特？在工场餐厅品尝「罐头菜」，吞拿鱼芝士蛋糕散发浓情滋味，有惊喜！到访逾三百年历史的酒庄，试饮味道清甜的波特酒，顺道分享品酒小知识。

programme.title: 玩转香港日与夜粤
programme.desc: 长洲两日一夜之旅，如何玩得特色又出色？陈志健、黄子恒、何浩文来到西湾一个历奇探险圣地，玩尽飞索、平衡车等新奇刺激玩意，期间还徒手攀上树顶，莫非他们打算挑战新一代「包山王」？三位男生踏足全岛最高的「北眺亭」，又到五行石欣赏无敌海景，只为寻找「男人的浪漫」！街边小吃「越吃越精采」，自己亲手炮制的「长洲芒果糯米糍」，滋味又如何？住长洲也可以住得有「营」，节目介绍岛上特色营地，体验印第安与欧陆风情。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 第六感亦称直觉或预感，是人类一种非透过五种基本感官所获得的感知能力。谷主滢仴自认直觉准确，甚至能分辨对方可有说谎，例如是前恋人。泳嘉、凯婷亦分享各自的预感经历，凯婷还整理了网上的第六感敏锐度测试。三位谷主讨论男、女性的第六感差异，并带出显意识与潜意识的概念，滢仴更笑言这集可为不少「欠细心」的男朋友平反，何出此言？凯婷亦提出有助训练第六感的方法，清洁房间、定期按摩也可能是有效途径之一？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 余思霆收拾好行李，请一日假便飞台北，获地胆拍档金刚接机，即搭机场捷运向市中心出发！旅程第一餐品尝足料鸡腿汤，未吃完已心思思要到宁夏夜市，寻觅同获「车胎人」推介的芋饼、猪肝汤与蚵仔煎。日间于隐世咖啡店享用三层塔茶点，夜晚深入窄巷酒吧，启动门口机关，走进以蜂巢为主题的设计格局并浅酌一番。翌晨，两人排长龙买早餐，再登上公园边赏花边医肚，偏黑色的卤肉饭有多滋味？下午行程有两款选择，叹啡、浸温泉，悉随尊便。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 旅途第二晚，吃到尽！先有抵食海鲜加肉材一人一锅，其他配料、蔬菜任添，再来意想不到的盐酥鸡当宵夜；连放松做Spa都有点心吃？第三日早上，两大行程可拣，好动的可以滑水，金刚体验「沙发滑水」，感受如何？爱静的可跟思霆往赤峰街商圈做个文青，购物、打卡、来个小清新套餐。终极血拼阶段，到永康街一带寻找合适手信，台湾特色小食、茶叶、精致生活小物，任君选择。上机前再享用炭火烹制的姜母鸭，记住金刚建议最后才吃鸭肉！

programme.title: 黄金盛宴粤
programme.desc: 黄金盛宴隆重举行，蔡澜、曾志伟、薛家燕、莫树锦、周中、谢宁、周汶锜应邀赴宴，由名贵鱼子酱与蟹肉头盘掀起序幕。周中还得Amanda S即磨黑松露片，美味直送入口。诺懿、保哥合力炮制软壳龙虾天妇罗，让来宾免剥壳尝味。Jacques即席重现经典「后冠小牛排」；鼎爷将东星斑片肉，再由诺懿用油泡熟，附上鲜甜鱼汤。肥妈「贵族黄油鸡」、阿爷「黄金炒饭」先后奉上，还有压轴巨形圣多诺黑蛋糕，皆获贵宾们高度评价！

programme.title: 快乐奇迹粤
programme.desc: 肺癌康复者罗翠媚曾被断定只可多活两个月，尤幸得到服用新药的机会，病情亦逐渐受控。当她以为逃过鬼门关如常上班之际，肿瘤却再次出现，而背后元凶可能是困扰不少港人的工作压力？亲友的鼓励，如何再让健康奇迹降临？芭蕾舞者雷晴雯因意外导致脊椎严重受创，自此不能走动。但她拒绝与轮椅结伴度过余生，并决定独自前赴台湾接受治疗，坚毅个性最终为她逆转人生！喜剧、笑片被指是能医百病的心灵良药，个中说法更有临床实证支持。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤PG
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 奇妙的动物之动物新纪录粤普
programme.desc: 什么动物腿最多？什么动物最爱干净？什么动物最长寿？想知道这些动物界神奇的世界纪录吗？快和皮皮龙一起走进奇妙的动物世界吧！探索动物新纪录，神奇发现全记住！

programme.title: 奇妙的动物之动物新纪录粤普
programme.desc: 什么动物腿最多？什么动物最爱干净？什么动物最长寿？想知道这些动物界神奇的世界纪录吗？快和皮皮龙一起走进奇妙的动物世界吧！探索动物新纪录，神奇发现全记住！

programme.title: 奇妙的动物之动物新纪录粤普
programme.desc: 什么动物腿最多？什么动物最爱干净？什么动物最长寿？想知道这些动物界神奇的世界纪录吗？快和皮皮龙一起走进奇妙的动物世界吧！探索动物新纪录，神奇发现全记住！

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 这次运动训练集中强化腹部和臀部，热身好就马上开始！躺下后利用腹部力量，尝试将双手碰脚尖、左右脚轮流上下移动，已有不少挑战。其后教练要大家维持「平板姿势」，将双脚轮流轻碰手肘；再以水樽作为负重，做「俄罗斯转体」，又能否应付得来？轮到臀部训练，身体向前倾，完成直腿后踢与侧踢。躺下做的动作会比较省力，但亦要留意一些细节，才能集中用到臀部发力。趴下做直脚上踢动作时，腰部要紧贴瑜伽垫，做起来也有一定难度。

programme.title: 成语动画廊粤
programme.desc: 《成语动画廊》以动画手法解说汉语成语的教育片，通过趣味浓厚的动画，让大家分享中国文化的独有宝藏。

programme.title: 科学×冒险 绝境求生手册粤日
programme.desc: 戴雅一行目击一颗类似流星的光球，这跟导致他们穿越时空的光球一模一样，继而决定找出光球坠落的地方。就在搜索途中，他们再次成为肉食恐龙的猎物！三人能否逃出生天，找到光球，回到原来的时代呢？

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 城崎与花轮最近言谈甚欢，距离亲近，令小渚深感不安，更哀求小丸子与小玉追查二人的关系。事实上，是城崎为了参加狗狗比赛，跟随花轮学习驯犬方法。小渚知情后，便拉上爱犬孤挺花，像城崎一样请教花轮。

programme.title: 荣宝斋粤
programme.desc: 节目聚焦荣宝斋代代坚守、薪火相传的百年历程，透过荣宝斋这一中国文化与艺术发展的重要缩影，展现中国传统文化的魅力与蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
香港中旅集团呈献：新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 医务委员会2018年曾改革，目标在两年内完成所有投诉个案，但过去五年只处理完约8,700宗投诉，约八成最终驳回，整体有六成一未达效率目标。上月医委会足足相隔15年才开庭处理一宗投诉医生疏忽的个案，引起政府高度关注，要求医委会八周内审视和完善投诉处理机制，申诉专员亦宣布展开全面调查，审研衞生署辖下的管理委员会秘书处。到底医委会的纪律研讯机制，能否增加透明度，令公众信服当中没有出现「医医相卫」？处理投诉个案的程序应该如何改善？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: Z 风暴粤
programme.desc: 一日，眼部受伤的女人突然出现在廉署总部，扬言要控告商业罪案调查科警司彬（林家栋饰）贪污，执行处首席调查主任廉（古天乐饰）接手调查，在追查过程中，廉发现身为警司的彬在执行职务时利用职权参与犯罪…

programme.title: 风味人间粤
programme.desc: 内蒙古于九月迎来莜麦的收成，其脂肪含量丰富，在地人会用来制成不同形状的面食。地处非洲的埃塞俄比亚则盛产苔麸，同样富含油脂，所制的英吉拉是当地主粮。广西侗族民众为庆祝婴儿诞生，会用经盐、糯米发酵制成的酸豇豆、酸肉等款待亲友，而酸鸭甚至腌制长达五年之久？冰岛人仍沿用古法，先藉发酵分解鲨鱼肉内的毒素，再脱水风干，风味独特。湖北荆州人会把江鱼起肉制成鱼糕；另将鱼尾煎香，即成当地日常早餐。

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 香港赛车手欧阳若曦正式退役，回望辉煌旅途有何感受？他还提到希望培育女儿参与赛车运动。保龄球世锦赛、香港壁球公开赛分别举行，港队主场出战，表现怎样？户外羽毛球世界杯将在阿联酋上演，港队积极备战。板网球银级赛汇聚逾二百位球手，送上比拼花絮。AI系统融入运动，如何藉分析动作来改善运动员水平？另带来学生运动员动向，重剑港青代表罗阡滺细说赴马来西亚交流得着；滚轴女将赵奭孜谈及于亚锦赛青年组速度过桩摘银点滴。

programme.title: 劲歌金榜粤
programme.desc: 主持许文轩(Edmond)每集紧贴金榜最新形势。此外，节目送上歌曲MV之余，Edmond还会带来歌手或音乐人的访问，跟观众畅谈作品，以至乐坛的人和事。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 招商局集团特约：天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 中信股份呈献：财经透视粤
programme.desc: 国际美酒展，是展示喝酒最新潮流的场合，今年参展商如何看产品销情？内地企业开拓海外市场，是大势所趋，香港在这方面如何配合？

programme.title: 新鲜人#15粤
programme.desc: 韦文、丽华正努力地清洁「材记」，欲替家辉筹备装修公司，家辉感激，决重振雄风。丽华得韦文热情相助，对她是韦权之妹的偏见全消。家谦、阮盈经常相约出外，韦文强要跟随，却备受冷落。自阮盈有家辉、家谦照顾，DY再没有跟踪她。家辉的装修公司开张，韦文请众人到母玉琴之斋铺吃饭庆祝，韦文不敢将暗恋家谦之事告诉玉琴，只敢向父成峰倾诉。韦文提议饭后到卡拉OK，并于深夜宣布自己生日，怎枓各人突然离去，剩韦文孤独渡过。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 玩转香港日与夜粤
programme.desc: 长洲两日一夜之旅，如何玩得特色又出色？陈志健、黄子恒、何浩文来到西湾一个历奇探险圣地，玩尽飞索、平衡车等新奇刺激玩意，期间还徒手攀上树顶，莫非他们打算挑战新一代「包山王」？三位男生踏足全岛最高的「北眺亭」，又到五行石欣赏无敌海景，只为寻找「男人的浪漫」！街边小吃「越吃越精采」，自己亲手炮制的「长洲芒果糯米糍」，滋味又如何？住长洲也可以住得有「营」，节目介绍岛上特色营地，体验印第安与欧陆风情。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 第六感亦称直觉或预感，是人类一种非透过五种基本感官所获得的感知能力。谷主滢仴自认直觉准确，甚至能分辨对方可有说谎，例如是前恋人。泳嘉、凯婷亦分享各自的预感经历，凯婷还整理了网上的第六感敏锐度测试。三位谷主讨论男、女性的第六感差异，并带出显意识与潜意识的概念，滢仴更笑言这集可为不少「欠细心」的男朋友平反，何出此言？凯婷亦提出有助训练第六感的方法，清洁房间、定期按摩也可能是有效途径之一？

programme.title: 香港本色粤
programme.desc: 黄大仙祠是香港著名的庙宇之一，黄大仙「信仰习俗」亦成功入选国家级非物质文化遗产名录。传统上，道长的职责是世代相传，若年轻人希望接触传统，成为道长，有何方法加入？相传黄大仙在民间赠医施药，我们不难发现「普济劝善」的精神在香港根深蒂固，不少团体亦会为有需要的市民提供免费诊症服务。除此之外，社会上还有甚么慈善活动与黄大仙有关？节目亦会介绍各种道服，「主科」、「幽科」、「青衣」等是在甚么场合穿着？

programme.title: 快乐奇迹粤
programme.desc: 肺癌康复者罗翠媚曾被断定只可多活两个月，尤幸得到服用新药的机会，病情亦逐渐受控。当她以为逃过鬼门关如常上班之际，肿瘤却再次出现，而背后元凶可能是困扰不少港人的工作压力？亲友的鼓励，如何再让健康奇迹降临？芭蕾舞者雷晴雯因意外导致脊椎严重受创，自此不能走动。但她拒绝与轮椅结伴度过余生，并决定独自前赴台湾接受治疗，坚毅个性最终为她逆转人生！喜剧、笑片被指是能医百病的心灵良药，个中说法更有临床实证支持。

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 巴基斯坦的木尔坦, 南亚最古老的城市。陪伴木尔坦人穿越沙漠的骆驼对他们来说是很珍贵的存在 死后的骆驼更被制作成骆驼皮灯，再画上传统的纳卡什图案，为木尔坦人照亮黑暗的尽头

programme.title: 排档寻情味粤英
programme.desc: 走进新加坡不同世代小贩的生活，感受他们之间的关爱、争吵以及他们对彼此坚定不移的支持。

programme.title: 一路前行II粤普
programme.desc: 节目由胡歌、刘涛和陈龙携手中国国家地理融媒体中心主任张辰亮以及一众新朋友，在节目中带观众走进自然，走进科学研究员、环保爱好者和当地居民的生活工作。

programme.desc: 哈皮和乐奇是邻居，他们跟帕普和邦迪一起住在乡下。哈皮和乐奇之间相处得很愉快，他们的生活充满了搞笑和欢乐。

programme.title: 功夫莫特
programme.desc: 莫特跟随师父修行了十年，但一直都只能处理一些和修练无关的琐事，某天，他们的村庄被妖怪入侵，师父命令莫特去解救村民，并嘱咐不可以真面貌示人，执行任务时，必须带著一个奇怪面具。对于这样的指示，莫特并不开心。因为所有的村民，包括他暗恋的妙仙，都非常崇拜著面具道士，所以莫特越来越想告诉大家真相…

programme.title: 灿烂的风和海(完)
programme.desc: 【赛车手失意澳门 邂逅冷艳策展人共度浪漫情缘】在灯火辉煌的摄影棚与璀璨夺目的澳门之间，广告导演麦又歌为梦想与责任奔波，结识热心单纯的机车青年徐君乐，在彼此的陪伴下逐渐打开封闭的心门。同时，赛车手韩俊豪在失利阴影与媒体质疑中挣扎，却因邂逅神秘策展人陈嘉慧，而重新燃起追寻自我的勇气。四人在工作、梦想与爱情的交织里相遇，既面对现实的压力，也学会倾听心底的渴望。在陌生却绚烂的城市里，他们将一同经历命运的考验，找寻属于自己的方向。

programme.title: 我的鲁蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人气英剧／鲁蛇舅舅Ｘ强迫症外甥温馨爆笑的家庭喜剧】由《虽然是精神病但没关系》的自闭症哥哥吴正世，首次担任男主角，在选秀节目中获胜的他，本该朝歌手梦前进，不料积蓄突然遭朋友骗光，从此一蹶不振，成为无业游名。某天因为姊姊与家暴丈夫离婚，而开始照顾起强迫症的外甥，过程中两人总是不断斗嘴，关系相爱又相杀，而他也从中找回责任感，成为外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【怪力妈搭配毒舌女母女笑闹同居火花不断】一个是凡事冲动、毫无对策的妈妈，一个是洒脱率性、走自己路的女儿。原本就像陌生人一样的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，鸡飞狗跳成为日常。从降职的糗事、误会的桃色风波，到接连不断的麻烦事件，她们在斗嘴中暗暗守护彼此。越是嫌弃对方，越是离不开对方——这场「陌生人同居记」，意外写下母女间最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴莲小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳时空穿越竟重逢前世伴侣】韩国狗血教母林成汉2023年全新力作！朝鲜时代的杜榴莲，虽嫁给丈夫朴一帅，但内心真正爱的是仆人石铁，碍于身分地位的落差，榴莲与石铁始终只能维持主仆关系，石铁更是遭婆婆痛下杀手。榴莲和石铁的儿子朴言，对金素贮一见钟情，两人马上结为夫妻，然而朴言骤然离世，伤痛欲绝的婆媳俩人，竟在月蚀之夜穿越到了现代，并在丹家别墅中再次见到了曾经的爱人、丈夫，在这一世中他们会擦出什么样的火花呢？

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 红色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母抛家嫁富豪弃子重生只为揭穿母亲真面目】一段因爱与欲望而撕裂的亲情，点燃了跨越二十年的复仇烈火。年轻时的熙琼为追逐荣华，狠心抛夫弃子，投入旧情人赫相怀抱，却一步步被权力与野心吞噬。她的女儿珍玛在父亲离世、母亲弃养的阴影下成长，怀著深深怨恨潜入熙琼身边，以设计师与「继孙女」的身分逐步揭穿母亲的虚伪面具。母女之间爱恨交织，真相与谎言、亲情与仇恨轮番交锋，最终将迎来一场足以摧毁一切的命运对决。

programme.title: 我把社长解锁了
programme.desc: 【人气网漫改编，影帝朴星雄解密手机AI的技术奇幻职场剧！】国内市占率最高的科技公司创办人天才CEO金成柱，因突发事件被杀手追杀成了谋杀案受害者，灵魂尚未离开人世而换个方式存活在刚大学毕业出社会朴仁成的手机内。为找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO开始两人的合作。

programme.title: Remember-儿子的战争
programme.desc: 【俞承豪为父申冤，朴敏英成为他正义路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇拥有过目不忘的记忆力，为了替被诬陷为杀人犯的父亲申冤成为了律师，与权势贪腐正面对抗。与坚守正义的检察官李仁雅，从质疑到并肩作战，成为振宇最坚强的后盾。就在逐步逼近真相时，却发现自己正逐渐失去记忆。他们携手在权力夹缝中拚搏，在时间与遗忘赛跑，只为守护真相与心中那份信念与爱。

programme.title: 两个人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞书欣锁定张彬彬，小太阳系女孩专治万年冰山。恋爱正在发芽中！！】时尚美妆部落客虞美人，外表光鲜亮丽，却始终放不下大学时期暗恋对象植物学教授庄羽。一次命运重逢，让她决定重新展开追爱计划。理性寡言的他，却对这位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐渐敞开心扉。从城市学校到乡村社会，从误解到理解，在一片绿意中，共筑属于彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治愈、慢慢相爱。

programme.desc: 【俞承豪为父申冤，朴敏英成为他正义路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇拥有过目不忘的记忆力，为了替被诬陷为杀人犯的父亲申冤成为了律师，与权势贪腐正面对抗。与坚守正义的检察官李仁雅，从质疑到并肩作战，成为振宇最坚强的后盾。就在逐步逼近真相时，却发现自己正逐渐失去记忆。他们携手在权力夹缝中拚搏，在时间与遗忘赛跑，只为守护真相与心中那份信念与爱。

programme.desc: 猪猪侠与同伴接收到来自九霄星的求救信号，尽管他们已经失去了强大的超能力，但热心肠的猪猪们仍然义无反顾地再次启航，前往那个充满未知数的陌生星球。来到九霄星后，猪猪们看到了整个星球的地表都被灼热的岩浆覆盖，而空中竟然悬浮着许多壮观宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，这些天空之城正在陆续失去能让它们悬浮的五灵元素，面临坠毁的威胁。猪猪侠等人寻找背后的原因，并耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪恶力量，使出浑身解数拯救天空之城。一场守护正义、保护天空之城的全新冒险之旅开始啦。

programme.title: 逆转女王
programme.desc: 【经典韩剧《贤内助女王》姊妹作】黄泰熙原是高薪的开发组长，但为了追求幸福家庭，她选择与新同事奉俊秀结婚。然而她的决定，却让她被信任的女上司赶出公司，只能在家当贤内助。五年后，泰熙感到现实生活的沉重，决定重返职场。在公司她遇见了具勇植，一位支持她的本部长。泰熙在勇植的鼓励下展现出更坚韧的一面，最终成功东山再起，找到了新的事业目标。

programme.title: 最佳爱情
programme.desc: 【知名编剧「洪氏姊妹」执笔当红VS过气偶像间的恋爱罗曼史】正值演艺巅峰的独孤振，不但是广告界宠儿，更是国民好感度第一的男星！而具爱贞则是前当红偶像团体「国宝少女」成员，因过气只好跑跑通告维持生计。独孤振在一次试镜中，因英语程度不佳，丢失了出演机会，没想到这丢人的秘密，居然被具爱贞给知道了！国民喜爱的男星碰上国民唾弃的女星，他们能克服众人的偏见勇敢去爱吗?一场荒谬又有趣的浪漫恋曲即将展开。

programme.title: 陷入纯情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成郑敬淏爱与复仇的心脏奇迹】没血没泪的冷酷企业代表姜敏浩，有著先天扩张性心藏病，面对随时有可能死亡的恐惧感，做起事来比谁都还心狠手辣。幼年父亲去世时，叔叔夺走了父亲的公司，高层主管们也纷纷选择背叛，庞大压力下母亲选择轻生留下敏浩一人。复仇心的驱使下，他成为GoldPartners的投资专家，同时也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大债权人团体，看似成功之际，却心脏病发命在旦夕，所幸出现心脏捐赠者，重生的他因细胞记忆而变得温暖，甚至对仇人女儿产生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的疗愈爱情故事。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 最佳爱情
programme.desc: 【知名编剧「洪氏姊妹」执笔当红VS过气偶像间的恋爱罗曼史】正值演艺巅峰的独孤振，不但是广告界宠儿，更是国民好感度第一的男星！而具爱贞则是前当红偶像团体「国宝少女」成员，因过气只好跑跑通告维持生计。独孤振在一次试镜中，因英语程度不佳，丢失了出演机会，没想到这丢人的秘密，居然被具爱贞给知道了！国民喜爱的男星碰上国民唾弃的女星，他们能克服众人的偏见勇敢去爱吗?一场荒谬又有趣的浪漫恋曲即将展开。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣领
programme.desc: 【改编荣获韩国网路小说悬疑类大奖，热血记者金荷娜携手前男友延玗臻联手调查！】擅长挖掘独家新闻的女记者徐贞媛，除事业上的成功，与作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚后生活也令人称羡。某日在犯罪现场成为了目击者，随著越演越烈的风波被怀疑为杀人犯，为证明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰宪寻求帮助，联手找寻真相。

programme.title: 少年时代
programme.desc: 【电影《原本以为只是手机掉了》任时完，大反派变小可怜少年，勇往直前成为校园新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生张秉泰，以「在学校不挨打」为最大目标。某天因父亲意外的关系，连夜逃到隔壁村，转学至扶余农高竟摇身一变成为学校老大，亲身体验强者生存的热血故事。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 暖阳之下
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.title: 爱情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永携手《社内相亲》薛仁雅寻找幸福小确幸！！！】清雅是一名放弃恋爱和结婚，努力在生活中，连续八年准备警察公务员却无法合格的社会小螺丝。俊辉则是一名对他人毫无兴趣的不婚主义者，不管是爱情、友情还是亲情都秉持N分之一的态度。认识了彼此开始寻找琐碎但现实的小确幸，并开始认知爱情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 暖阳之下
programme.desc: 【温馨陆剧/二宝＆事业该选谁？ 都市夫妻的两难抉择！】宋思凝怀著梦想只身来到北京，经过多年打拼终于成为公司的人力总监，与创意公司总经理李俊龙成为夫妻，并育有一儿，日子过得幸福美满。但在婚育观上，两人的想法有极大的分歧，经常为了女儿的教育问题争吵，李俊龙希望能与思凝生育二宝，然而正值事业上升期的思凝，面临自我实现与家庭的两难冲突，在大都会生活的两人又该如何抉择呢？

programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: ONE Fight Night 38: Andrade vs. Baatarkhuu
programme.desc: The stars will shine the brightest when the world’s largest martial arts organization returns to the Thai capital for ONE Fight Night 38: Andrade vs. Baatarkhuu. This blockbuster showcase features several martial arts veterans, and it will be topped by a pair of must-see World Title battles. In the headline attraction, ONE Bantamweight MMA World Champion Fabricio Andrade looks to continue his reign of devastation and cap off the year with another highlight-reel knockout for the ages. But #4-ranked contender Enkh-Orgil Baatarkhuu, who is fresh off his appearance on Netflix’s Physical: 100, wants to follow in the footsteps of his mentor Narantungalag Jadambaa and become the next Mongolian to capture ONE World Title gold. In the co-main event, two-time ADCC World Champion Diogo “Baby Shark” Reis will square off against Japanese BJJ black belt Daiki Yonekura for the ONE Flyweight Submission Grappling World Title. Plus, British Muay Thai legend Liam Harrison, BJJ icon Marcelo Garcia...

programme.desc: After Thomas loses his voice, he must find a new way to pass on a very important message.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: Lover's Rock
programme.desc: Pan Lei, winner the China Literary Award for three consecutive years, wrote and directed this film about the lives and loves of a fishing village. It starred the glorious Cheng Pei-pei in her first film as a woman (she had debuted in a man's role), and her much-lauded performance won her the prestigious Golden Accolade Award from the International Association Of Independent Producers a first for any Asian woman.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: As its name implies, Songfest is an Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical, traditionally Chinese and timeless in content; yet revealing a spirited and modern technique. Shot on location at Taiwan's beautiful Sun-Moon Lake, it's a turbulent romance between a passionate tea picker Sung Yu Lan and a charming fisherman Li Chun Yang.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Orphaned lawyer Raymond Lau once helped clear hooker Lan of murder charges, not knowing that Lan is his mother. When a corrupt cop blackmails Lan with Raymond's identity, she kills him out of desperation. When Raymond is enlisted again to defend Lan, he uncovers the secret that she has been hiding about their relationship for years.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: Joey looks to start a new life after a failed suicide attempt but finds herself pregnant and dare not tell her ex-boyfriend. At the same time, she realizes that a mysterious woman is stalking her and begins to hallucinate, leading to a nervous breakdown. Taking advice from an abbot, Joey decides to uncover the truth in order to protect her baby...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.desc: The crew meets their blue-hued doppelgängers when they crash-land on an alien planet where kids call all the shots.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Aggravated Assault Of The Alien Armada
programme.desc: Oh, the indignity: George and Harold are forced to perform spa treatments on gigantic Biglyans. Also, Dr. Fitzgibbons reveals a shocking secret.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Saving Shattermaster
programme.desc: When Mala and the Defenders of the Wing find a mysterious stranger who looks suspiciously like Dagur, Hiccup and Heather go to investigate.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Dire Straits
programme.desc: Viggo gets angry at the dragon riders continually interfering with his business and uses a deep sea dragon, the Submaripper, to control Berk's trade.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Postmortem
programme.desc: Tensions run high within team Voltron as they discuss Lotor’s fate and try to figure out their next move

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Wrestlebabia: The Musica Flowers For Munk
programme.desc: When Sandy can't join animal wrestling she poses as "Mandy Monkhuahua"; In order to help Munk, Grug sticks super worms up his nose that make him smarter

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Jam Jam
programme.desc: The PALs try to figure out why Marciela is acting so weird, while Miradero is gripped by April Fool’s Day fever

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Bridge
programme.desc: A group of Trux displaced by a volcano comes to Ty for help, and the gang has to work together to build a bridge to welcome their new guests.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Lots Of Raa's In The Jungle
programme.desc: Raa Raa and all his friends are finding out about different animals, they charge around being a pride of lions, a tower of giraffes etc… until Zebby wonders what zebras do… together the animals discover that zebras stampede… which is great fun and very noisy!

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Favourite Things
programme.desc: Raa Raa wants to show Topsy his three favourite things. But when he gets to his friends house, they have disappeared. Raa Raa and his friends set out on a noisy adventure to find the missing objects

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Jungle Jiggles
programme.desc: Raa Raa wants a partner to dance a noisy stompy dance with. All the animals have their own way of dancing, apart from Zebby who says she is too shy to dance… or is she?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Great Big Noise
programme.desc: Raa Raa has decided that the jingly jangly jungle is not jingly or jangly enough. He and his friends make lots of noise, but soon learn that they need to work together to make a wonderful jingly jangly jungle noise.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Nap Time Story
programme.desc: Topsy is going to read Zebby a naptime story. Raa Raa wants to make the noises to go with the story. But they are all too loud and poor Zebby can't get to sleep. Can Raa Raa find any quiet sleepy noises in the Jingly Jangly Jungle?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Go Bananas
programme.desc: Ooo Ooo is having a banana party. Raa Raa and the others have picked masses of lovely bananas, but how are they going to transport them back to Ooo Ooo's in time for the party?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ's Glow Ride
programme.desc: Gabby receives a special nighttime delivery, unboxing a glow-in-the-dark train engine. However, she realizes that she's missing the other three train cars to complete the whole train. programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Gearwigs

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: All the animals are having a nap. But Raa Raa and Ooo Ooo aren't tired and want to play… will they have enough energy to last until everyone else wakes up?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Whistle Worries
programme.desc: Raa Raa is determined that he can copy all the noises in the Jingly Jangly Jungle… until he hears Topsy whistling. Try as he might, Raa Raa just can't whistle. All his jungle friends help Raa Raa to learn to whistle.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa Gets Hiccups
programme.desc: Raa Raa can't get rid of his hiccups. Can his friends help him?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Ooo Ooo's Wriggly Jiggly Game
programme.desc: Topsy is having a party and Raa Raa is helping organise the games. But not everybody is good at them. Can Raa Raa and his friends come up with new games that all the friends are good at and enjoy?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Perfect Present
programme.desc: Raa Raa is sure he has found the perfect present for each of his friends… but what happens if the packages get mixed up?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa The Copycat
programme.desc: Raa Raa is playing a game - copying everyone in the jungle. He soon distracts his friends… but can he put the game to good use?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Spaceship
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a spaceship that takes off with a sleeping CatRat inside! Gabby, Pandy, and Kitty Fairy have to get the ship back into The Fairy Tail Garden before Floyd (who thinks it's the best kitty toy ever!) gets his paws on it!

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Empty Is The Head
programme.desc: Exhausted from settling his subjects' disputes, King Julien replaces himself with a dummy king so he can play hooky, unwittingly sparking a rebellion.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - A Hole New World
programme.desc: Tom and Jun encounter unexpected dangers and are separated while exploring the Hidden Realm of dragons. Tom introduces Jun to the dragon world, and Jun bonds with a dragon of her own - Wu and Wei.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Dragon Club
programme.desc: Tom and Jun take a risk in revealing the secret of the Hidden Realm to D’Angelo to aid an injured dragon, and D’Angelo bonds with Plowhorn.

programme.desc: After a shocking revelation, Po is determined to get his chi back and Jing decides to face Jindiao

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws Of Destiny S1 - Return of the Four Constellations
programme.desc: The kids go to the Spirit Realm and meet the Original Four Constellations in the hopes of learning how to defeat Jindiao

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - King Pickles
programme.desc: When Kid Pickles is feeling down on his birthday, Puss and Artephius create a magical scroll that names Kid Pickles as heir to the San Lorenzo throne.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Pirate Booty
programme.desc: After pirates invade San Lorenzo searching for mystical treasure, Puss leads them on the hunt, hoping his share will defend against the Bloodwolf

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Qilin-mania
programme.desc: Superstar-level mania sets in when the renowned and prosperity-brining creature Qilin appears in front of Yi’s building. In trying to protect Qilin from the mob of people hoping for their wishes to be granted, the crew is distraught when they lose track of the creature. Their distress grows upon discovering that this "Qilin" isn’t an auspicious mythical creature at all but a nefarious robot sent by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Shack Attack
programme.desc: "The crew tracks down the source of the havoc-wreaking robot "Qilin" and winds up trapped by Mr. Lung, the Minticon-using candymaker who disappeared in Season_x000D_1. While captive, Yi and the crew learn of a higher power known as the Great Watchers, and that Mr. Lung is furious at Yi for unwittingly replacing him as the GW-approved keeper of magical creatures. Saddled with these mind-blowing revelations, the crew must find a way to escape and stop Mr. Lung from using creature magic for evil."

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Gabby Gets The Hiccups
programme.desc: The dollhouse delivery is a cat-in-the-box that startles Gabby, giving her the hiccups. Dr. Pandy and the Gabby Cats try several cures, but it isn't until CatRat scares the hiccups out of Gabby that they go away!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Hamster Kitties
programme.desc: When 6 adorable hamster kitties get loose in the dollhouse, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box head out to look for them. Along the way, Baby Box learns a lot about hamster kitties, which convinces Mama Box to let them live in the Craft Room.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty School
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a school notebook and lunch box, it's Kitty School Day in the dollhouse! Gabby and Pandy head to different classes held by the Gabby Cats to learn and live a day in the life of a student.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Remote Control
programme.desc: Bored of the viewing options on window, Thunk realizes what he’s been missing - real life drama! But when Thunk starts creating drama around the farm, the others set out to teach him a lesson.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Daddy Daughter Day
programme.desc: Sandy is finally old enough to join Grug and Eep for the annual Daddy Daughter Day and Grug couldn’t be more excited. But when Sandy struggles to fit in with Grug and Eep’s traditions, Grug has second thoughts. It isn’t until Sandy goes missing that Grug realizes it’s time to start a new tradition.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - There’s No Phil in Team
programme.desc: When Phil humiliates himself playing throw-go-nut with the punch monkeys, the Croods band together to help him regain his confidence. Unfortunately, Phil goes from confident to cocky and bets the farm on a game of throw-go-nut with the punch monkeys. Can_x000D_the Croods overcome the punch monkeys - and Phil - to save the farm?

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Ride or Die
programme.desc: After a fight with her mom, Jun joins Tom on an adventure into the Fire Realm, where the knowledge of myths saves the day.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Empty Fireworm Nest
programme.desc: When a tiny Fireworm dragon ends up at ICARIS, Alex has to decide between her moms’ excitement and keeping the dragon secret.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Dr. Catastrophe

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Leonardo Stands Alone

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Follow the Sprinkles Canyon Valley V. Dirk

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Knock Knock, Who's There? Pat Hearts Squid
programme.desc: SpongeBob watches Mr. Krabs's house while he's away, so he takes extreme measures to make sure no one breaks in. Squidward is forced to room with Patrick, but his domineering demeanor rubs off on Patrick more than he'd like.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Lighthouse Louie Hiccup Plague

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - The Patterfly Effect A Space Affair to Remember

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Slink or Swim The Big Chill
programme.desc: When Bobby finds out Carl can't swim, he offers to show him the ways of the waves! After begging Abuelo for some AC, the cousins decide to earn some cash at the neighborhood fair.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Karma Chameleon Team Effort

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Zoo-mergency!

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP14
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP3
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: Get On A Flat - EP19
programme.desc: Rewind to the 2008 financial crisis and supermarket manager Che Chi-ming (Andrew Lam) hurriedly sells his apartment. Who could have known even though Chi-ming has been chasing after property prices for 14 years, he still cannot get on the property ladder once again. A middle class lifestyle is tragically transformed into a "midlife crisis"._x000D__x000D_Chi-ming’s wife Man Wai (Elena Kong) is obsessed with property ownership. She goes to work as a part-time maid at some luxury home.

programme.title: Fist Within Four Walls, A - EP28
programme.desc: CHOR AU-KUEN (Ruco Chan) bears the grief of the loss of his family and returns to the walled city in hopes of finding his long lost sister, only to find out that the place he grew up in has become a lawless no man's land. Concealing his real identity as a Bajiquan master, he creates a new identity and gets acquainted with a feisty hair salon lady boss, TIU LAN (Nancy Wu), a dentist, DUEN YING-FUNG (Benjamin Yuen), and a worker, BUT TAK-LIU (Lam Tsz Sin).

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP6
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP15
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP4
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: Get On A Flat - EP20
programme.desc: Rewind to the 2008 financial crisis and supermarket manager Che Chi-ming (Andrew Lam) hurriedly sells his apartment. Who could have known even though Chi-ming has been chasing after property prices for 14 years, he still cannot get on the property ladder once again. A middle class lifestyle is tragically transformed into a "midlife crisis"._x000D__x000D_Chi-ming’s wife Man Wai (Elena Kong) is obsessed with property ownership. She goes to work as a part-time maid at some luxury home.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP1
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. programme.title: Shadow Of Justice - EP19
programme.desc: Because of some transfer arrangement and several complicated cases, AICIP Au Yeung Chung (Bobby Au Yeung) and CUSP Tsui Hay-yi (Joey Meng) become collaborating partners. The duo have mutual understanding. Sheung Siu (Jeannie Chan), daughter of a logistics company boss, hates Au Yeung Chung as she is certain that he has caused her family to break up. Au Yeung Chung had promised the late Mrs. Sheung he would be tolerant of Sheung Siu.

programme.desc: 全球经济正面临“高通胀、高利率、高债务”和地缘政治冲突的多重挑战，在此背景之下，国际航运市场正面临着前所未有的复杂局面。当“临时性”地缘政治溢价与“永久性”绿色成本叠加，长距离的贸易路线是否会变得不再经济？面对美国关税政策带来的贸易路径潜在转变，以及全球绿色航运征税带来的成本结构变化，上海又将如何发力，以巩固和提升其全球竞争力？10月19日15:00，第一财经特邀重磅行业嘉宾，在思想碰撞中厘清迷局，为行业在巨变中把握新机遇提供前瞻视角与深刻洞察。

programme.title: NBF FLOW LIVE丨开拓与创新：民营航运增添行业新活力
programme.desc: 在全球贸易格局深刻变革、科技革命与低碳转型交织的今天，中国航运业正迎来前所未有的机遇与挑战。民营经济作为我国航运生态中不可或缺的力量，以其灵活的机制、敏锐的市场嗅觉和持续的创新精神，为行业高质量发展注入了蓬勃的“新活力”。\r\n本次圆桌论坛以 “韧性与创新” 为核心，特邀四位来自航运产业链关键环节的领军企业家，共同探讨民营航运企业如何在外贸变局中破浪前行，如何以数字化与绿色化“双轮驱动”重构行业竞争力，以及如何在服务出海大潮中开辟新蓝海。

programme.title: 直播丨2025北外滩国际航运论坛·金融与保险论坛
programme.desc: “金融与保险”论坛将紧紧围绕“开放创新合作，共促航运服务业高质量发展”的主题开展研讨，重点聚焦航运交易、航运金融、航运保险、航运指数衍生品等服务创新，结合当下时事热点，特别是行业数智化和绿色化发展趋势带来的机遇与挑战，为金融与保险等服务更加精准高效地支撑实体经济转型升级、提升上海国际航运中心服务能级，为全球航运业健康繁荣发展集聚智慧，提供交流和展示的平台。

programme.title: 直播丨2025北外滩国际航运论坛·海上交通安全论坛
programme.desc: 深入践行新发展理念，促进海上交通安全合作与交流，助力全球航运高质量发展。论坛紧密结合当前国际航运业发展新形势和新变化，为业界探析行业热点、研讨海事政策、提升救捞能力、促进海上搜救合作和分享经验成果搭建交流平台，携手共建海上交通大安全格局。

programme.title: NBF FLOW LIVE丨世界经贸潮汐涌动 全球航运破浪前行
programme.desc: 全球经济正面临“高通胀、高利率、高债务”和地缘政治冲突的多重挑战，在此背景之下，国际航运市场正面临着前所未有的复杂局面。当“临时性”地缘政治溢价与“永久性”绿色成本叠加，长距离的贸易路线是否会变得不再经济？面对美国关税政策带来的贸易路径潜在转变，以及全球绿色航运征税带来的成本结构变化，上海又将如何发力，以巩固和提升其全球竞争力？10月19日15:00，第一财经特邀重磅行业嘉宾，在思想碰撞中厘清迷局，为行业在巨变中把握新机遇提供前瞻视角与深刻洞察。

programme.title: 直播丨 2025北外滩国际航运论坛·国际海运论坛
programme.desc: 当前，世界正经历“百年未有之大变局”，全球经济格局深度调整，地缘政治风险加剧，供应链不稳定性凸显，人工智能等技术加速重构产业生态，绿色转型已成为全球共识。面对这些变化和挑战，航运业将以开放促合作，以创新谋发展，通过技术革命性突破、生产要素创新性配置、产业深度转型升级，培育推动行业高质量发展的新质生产力，为保障全球产业链供应链安全畅通、推动构建人类命运共同体贡献力量。

programme.title: 直播丨2025北外滩国际航运论坛·国际航空论坛
programme.desc: 2025年北外滩国际航空论坛继续在上海市人民政府和交通运输部指导下，由中国东方航空和上海机场集团联合主办，以\"创新领航 智链未来——科技赋能全球航空新格局\"为主题，致力于打造全球航空业高端对话平台，为建设交通强国和民航强国贡献智慧力量。

programme.title: NBF FLOW LIVE丨打造世界级航空货运枢纽 赋能全球供应链重塑
programme.desc: 本场大放送从 “现状与布局”“挑战与应对”“未来与创新” 三大维度切入，既探讨我国航空货运枢纽在硬件设施、业务布局、行业基础等方面的核心优势，以及全球顶尖枢纽的可借鉴经验；也剖析跨主体协同、运力稳定、政策协同等现实挑战与应对策略；还展望枢纽在国际航线拓展、智能化、绿色化等领域的未来规划，为观众呈现我国航空货运枢纽建设的全貌与发展方向，助力理解其对全球供应链重塑的重要意义。

programme.title: 一线论坛丨第二十二届上海知识产权国际论坛分论坛：人工智能时代的知识产权运营管理
programme.desc: 作为知识产权领域具有重要影响力的活动和展示上海知识产权事业发展的重要舞台，第二十二届上海知识产权国际论坛分论坛的主题为“人工智能时代的知识产权运营管理”，将汇聚来自国内外知识产权行政部门、国际组织、跨国企业、研究机构和高校知识产权领域专家学者和实务人员，碰撞智慧火花，进一步为科技创新、经济发展和社会进步提供有力支撑。

programme.title: 直播丨【共潮生】香帅年度展望·2025
programme.desc: 旧世界的坐标系已经失效，经济秩序发生三大重置——资产价格、产业链、消费市场。2025年《共潮生｜香帅年度展望》，在未来图景初显轮廓之际，我们一起去看看关于新世界、新秩序、新财富的故事。共潮而生，一起启航！

programme.title: 直播丨【聚势·共进】2025中金财富1018发布会
programme.desc: 2025中金财富1018发布会启幕在即，诚邀您共赴年度之约。\r\n2025年是中金公司成立30周年，亦是中金财富买方投顾资产保有规模跨越千亿的里程碑时刻。我们期盼与您共同携手打造共生共赢共享的价值共创生态，助力财富管理行业高质量发展。\r\n本次发布会将涵盖宏观研究、买方投顾、全球配置、金融科技、普惠金融五大模块内容，敬请关注。

programme.title: NBF FLOW LIVE丨潮涌百年：从沙船之乡到世界大港
programme.desc: 2025北外滩国际航运论坛即将举行，特邀中国航运领域业内人士圆桌夜话，以人文见未来的视角，通过多轮“潮汐对谈”，将“航运智慧传承”、“绿色发展航道”、“智慧航运枢纽”等主题赋予了温度和故事性；传播上海建设国际航运中心愿景，描绘中国航运产业发展蓝图。

programme.title: 变革者对话：连接未来·锻造韧性——践行联合国全球契约十项原则丨可持续供应链论坛
programme.desc: 在恢复建院40周年之际，复旦大学管理学院携手联合国全球契约组织在华联络办公室、第一财经可持续发展研究中心，共同发起“25可持续发展链主联盟”项目，旨在打造供应链可持续管理的行业标杆平台。在此背景下，“变革者对话：连接未来・锻造韧性 —— 践行联合国全球契约十项原则” 可持续供应链论坛围绕全链碳中和实践、韧性供应链构建等话题，邀请专家学者与企业嘉宾分享碳中和管理、绿色采购、数字化供应链等案例与思考。

programme.title: 2025指数与量化投资发展论坛丨全球资产管理中心 上海国际活动周2025
programme.desc: 2025年10月18日，由上海资产管理协会主办，虹口区金融服务中心、上海资产管理协会指数与量化投资专业委员会承办，上海对冲基金园区支持的“2025指数与量化投资发展论坛”将在上海市虹口区北外滩来福士隆重举行。\r\n本届论坛以“证券投资的科技思想、方法原理”为主题，特别邀请十余位业内专家，从理论原理出发，共同探讨指数与量化投资在各资产管理子行业的应用实践。论坛期间，将举行“上海对冲基金园区”迁址与“上海资产管理协会指数与量化投资专业委员会”揭牌。

programme.title: LIVE丨THE 22ND SHANGHAI INTERNATIONAL INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY FORUM
programme.desc: The Forum will bring together experts and scholars from home and abroad, spark intellectual exchanges, draw on advanced intellectual property governance concepts and development experiences worldwide, and further provide strong support for scientific and technological innovation, economic development and social progress. The Forum will invite representatives from international organizations, government departments from China and abroad, business associations, enterprises, research institutions, universities and intellectual property service agencies to conduct in-depth discussions and exchanges.

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎么那么可爱2第15集
programme.desc: 时间来到2012年，彩香迈入六十六岁，什么都不缺。财富自由、身体堪用、爱情稳定，不受孩子牵绊，发贵小鸥为伴，可说是「六六大顺」。以为晚年就这样了，但…天外竟飞来一哥的老母亲，彩香的人生进入番外篇，扮起她人生没扮过的角色：媳妇。

programme.title: 阿叔第5集
programme.desc: 王文钦从小住在嘉义朴子，是当地唯一的「木工家具修复师」，传承老一辈的工匠精神，文钦做事认真，初恋没有开花结果的他，一生未娶，独力抚养姪子姪女。他不仅修复破损的家具，更看见历史的痕迹和故事。而他深切希望修复自己的老家，找回失落的家具，延续家族的回忆。 文钦的初恋情人纪明珠从台北回到嘉义朴子，揭开了文钦不为人知的过去与隐藏的秘密。其后两人开始重新找寻新的情感模式，修复了心中那些被时间模糊的回忆和情感。文钦用他的技艺和爱心，修复人们与自己心中的缺憾，并带来了希望与温暖

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 女士的品格(台)第17集
programme.desc: KPI至上的工作狂姚薇在事业上升期发现自己怀孕了。得知姚薇怀孕，公司挖角安畅来商务部做总监。安畅不仅有资历、老公加持，还是顶客族，完美避开女性在职场的部分困境。纠结后，姚薇选择生下孩子。就是这个决定让一切发生了变化。

programme.title: 百年巨匠-梅兰芳第40集
programme.desc: 《百年巨匠》是一部大规模、全方位拍摄制作的关于近代艺术大师、画坛巨匠的大型人物传记系列纪录片，用独特的影视镜头语言对20世纪中国画坛上最具影响力的艺术巨匠进行的全方位的影像解读和人物诠释。动人心弦、精彩纷呈的人物故事，再现了一代艺术大师真实生动、极富传奇色彩的人生历程。故事起伏跌宕，感人至深，具有不可多得的文献价值和赏心悦目的审美价值。

programme.title: 阎小妹第1集
programme.desc: 这是一座介于乡村与都市间的迷你化、可爱化的小城镇-东閰镇。里面住著许多东方传说中的人物、妖怪以及拟人化的动物。故事主人翁閰小妹是东閰镇镇长的独生女，就读东閰国小三年级，班上有各式各样的妖怪同学，还有一位来自西方的留学生迪米欧。迪米欧和閰小妹两人成为一对有趣的搭档，产生出许多好玩的趣事。在东閰镇里，每天可以认识许多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每个角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被发掘。閰小妹将带领著迪米欧与同学们在东閰城里一起学习、一起探险，也将引导观众，重新认识华人文化里，最具奇幻魅力的异想世界。

programme.desc: 节目邀请到大家熟悉的「万人美老师」－郭昱晴担任主持人。以系列为节目核心，邀请在相同体系内，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其坚守追求专业的精神与受挫不懈的毅力。并且将依照不同专业，结合生活观点，推出相符的小单元。内容兼具权威与风趣，不仅拉近观众与来宾距离，也从中看到来宾不为人知的另一面。如节目中热血仁医系列，除了分享医生在白色巨塔中奋斗的故事之外，也会依其专业，在预防医学的概念下，加入医疗科技新资讯及独门养生撇步等小单元。

programme.title: 阎小妹第1集
programme.desc: 这是一座介于乡村与都市间的迷你化、可爱化的小城镇-东閰镇。里面住著许多东方传说中的人物、妖怪以及拟人化的动物。故事主人翁閰小妹是东閰镇镇长的独生女，就读东閰国小三年级，班上有各式各样的妖怪同学，还有一位来自西方的留学生迪米欧。迪米欧和閰小妹两人成为一对有趣的搭档，产生出许多好玩的趣事。在东閰镇里，每天可以认识许多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每个角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被发掘。閰小妹将带领著迪米欧与同学们在东閰城里一起学习、一起探险，也将引导观众，重新认识华人文化里，最具奇幻魅力的异想世界。

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1642集
programme.desc: 人间卫视【生活智多星】邀请到「好门媳妇」－郁方担任主持人，透过轻松活泼的访谈，让您成为生活上「智多星」。本节目邀请不同领域的专家学者，从科学的观点，深入浅出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑虑与似是而非的伪知识，了解事情的源由与真相，提供不一样的想法与见解。【生活智多星】内容丰富多元，例如针对银发族的需求，邀请银发族运动专家，将因久坐而气滞血瘀的沙发马铃薯大变身，强力打造出活力四射、充满元气的不老传说。以及有关吃的大哉问：吃进嘴里的是营养还是毒药，吃的顺序、吃的方法与吃的健康，从不吃坏肚子到吃到强身健体，【生活智多星】全面关心。

programme.title: 人间佛学院第251集
programme.desc: 人间佛学院希望能带领观众研习佛学义理，深入经藏智慧的法门，将人间佛教的理念，彻底落实在我们日常生活当中，且听人间佛教的修行者深入浅出地带您遨游浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: 名人书房第58集
programme.desc: 阅读引导我们漫步在别人的思想与灵魂当中13位名人的读书故事，13段动人的奇幻旅程~继2015年与中天电视合作制播《名人床头书》节目，邀请39位名人深度分享阅读带来的影响及美好，冠德玉山教育基金会于2018年起独立制作《名人书房》影片，以阅读为主题的实景记录，期待能呈现文学、艺术、设计、空间等风格意义，邀请王伟忠、五月天/石头、江坤俊、姚谦、郎祖筠、许芳宜、郭重兴、曾文诚、曾宝仪、郑丰、徐薇X大成、刘安婷X吕冠纬等跨界名人，由资深主播詹庆龄担任主持人，在漫漫的引言互动中，侃侃而谈对生命的感知、阅读经验的分享与追梦的过程。影片片头「名人书房」由《每日一字》书法家张炳煌挥毫，配乐为大提琴家吕超伦演奏

programme.title: 女士的品格第18集
programme.desc: KPI至上的工作狂姚薇在事业上升期发现自己怀孕了。得知姚薇怀孕，公司挖角安畅来商务部做总监。安畅不仅有资历、老公加持，还是顶客族，完美避开女性在职场的部分困境。纠结后，姚薇选择生下孩子。就是这个决定让一切发生了变化。

programme.title: 百年巨匠-梅兰芳第41集
programme.desc: 《百年巨匠》是一部大规模、全方位拍摄制作的关于近代艺术大师、画坛巨匠的大型人物传记系列纪录片，用独特的影视镜头语言对20世纪中国画坛上最具影响力的艺术巨匠进行的全方位的影像解读和人物诠释。动人心弦、精彩纷呈的人物故事，再现了一代艺术大师真实生动、极富传奇色彩的人生历程。故事起伏跌宕，感人至深，具有不可多得的文献价值和赏心悦目的审美价值。

programme.title: 土壤的身世第5集
programme.desc: 土壤是本片主角，用第一人称手法做为主轴串连，诠释台湾土壤独特的个性、脾气、习惯和美貌，看她如何在夹缝中求生存、如何与保育工作者及科学家们亲密对话，以期能达到捍卫物种生命、保护环境的潜移默化效果。

programme.title: 新北厚所在第19集
programme.desc: 深耕新北市的13家有线电视业者联合制播「新北厚所在」，除了延续第一季以人文、历史、地景、风俗的丰富内容外，第二季将加入新住民、原住民及性别平等的议题，让节目内容更为丰富多元。

programme.title: 文艺赋格第28集

programme.title: 另一种注目第28集
programme.desc: 《另一种注目》是一个具文化精神的纪实节目，从各种人物故事切入，以崭新的视野与独特的观点，探索台湾社会文化的现象与脉络，为这个时代留下纪录。

programme.title: 人生调色盘第79集
programme.desc: 歌仔戏小生陈亚兰小姐首次独挑大梁，主持深度人物访谈节目【人生调色盘】。 「人生」问题是一门大学问，悲欢离合、生老病死是每个人会经历的过程，特别是随著社会发展而衍生出新的问题，例如职场与网路的霸凌、忧郁症、亲人失智长照…等，都是过去所罕见的。 节目透过嘉宾的经验分享，辅以专家学者从旁论述分析，掌握选择的思考过程，厘清正确的观念，借以产生改变自己的能量。主持人陈亚兰也发挥歌仔戏隐恶扬善的精神，将「忠孝节义」的处世准则，于节目中传播出去。 为了推广台语之美，特别规划「亚兰话俗语」单元，每集介绍一句台湾俚俗语，简单直白却字字珠玑，不仅学习到老祖宗的智慧，也贴近自己的人生。

programme.title: 2024未来与希望系列讲座第40集
programme.desc: 佛光山惠中寺2024未来与希望系列讲座以「古．今」为主题，邀请台湾诗人、散文家、现任台湾师范大学国文研究所兼任教授陈义芝，主讲「诗心接千载：古典与现代」。佛光山中区总住持觉居法师开场介绍，陈义芝老师出版著作30本，超过一半是诗集，对现代诗的用心极深。

programme.title: 探索大脑第1集
programme.desc: 邀请学者专家与医学界各科相关医师，针对不同的脑部相关议题进行讨论与提醒，借由浅显易懂的医疗科学，一窥复杂精密的大脑结构，节目中还加入探讨脑部相关疾病的片段电影，让大众更容易认识脑部衰退带来的生活影响，并有简易的养生操教学，预防脑部疾病，欢迎收看本节目，让我们一起来探索大脑！

programme.title: 艺海扬芬第6集
programme.desc: 「艺海扬芬」是文化部国立新竹生活美学馆推动的「百年公会堂人物影像民族志」计划。它以影像纪录与刊物出版的方式，记录台湾北部九县市资深艺术家的创作轨迹与生命故事，借此传承珍贵的艺术文化资产。计划已访谈并记录多位不同领域的艺术家，透过纪录片与专刊让大众认识这些对文化传承有重大贡献的人物。

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 人生调色盘第229集
programme.desc: 歌仔戏小生陈亚兰小姐首次独挑大梁，主持深度人物访谈节目【人生调色盘】。 「人生」问题是一门大学问，悲欢离合、生老病死是每个人会经历的过程，特别是随著社会发展而衍生出新的问题，例如职场与网路的霸凌、忧郁症、亲人失智长照…等，都是过去所罕见的。 节目透过嘉宾的经验分享，辅以专家学者从旁论述分析，掌握选择的思考过程，厘清正确的观念，借以产生改变自己的能量。主持人陈亚兰也发挥歌仔戏隐恶扬善的精神，将「忠孝节义」的处世准则，于节目中传播出去。 为了推广台语之美，特别规划「亚兰话俗语」单元，每集介绍一句台湾俚俗语，简单直白却字字珠玑，不仅学习到老祖宗的智慧，也贴近自己的人生。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第17集
programme.desc: 突破一般记录报导影片，平实却易流于平淡无味的刻板手法，另类开创了户外探险、旅游行脚节目，深度好看、知性感性兼顾，又能将文字与音乐有如行云流水般的自然融入，重要的是，我们及时保存下许多消逝的声音、消逝的物种、消逝的故事…

programme.title: 文艺赋格第29集
programme.desc: 融合在地与全球，开拓多元丰富的文化景观。如同音乐「赋格」一般的创作形式，众声云集，成就台湾文艺的合唱。

programme.title: 另一种注目第29集
programme.desc: 《另一种注目》是一个具文化精神的纪实节目，从各种人物故事切入，以崭新的视野与独特的观点，探索台湾社会文化的现象与脉络，为这个时代留下纪录。

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第371集
programme.desc: 台视60周年台庆大戏《美丽人生》第五单元《壮志高飞》，以1960年代高雄市旗津岛为故事起点，三位最美丽的台湾女人，在台湾最美丽的年代，在最美丽的旗津，悲欢交织而成的美丽人生。数百年前，旗津还没有一个统一的名称，岛的南端依旧与高雄相连。 而后，为了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名唤『崩隙』的这片沙土挖空了，居民被迫迁移，旗津也因而断开 了与台湾的连系，犹如游子，离开了母亲的怀抱。土地会消失，历史也许会被淡忘，但曾经走过那段艰辛岁月的人们，他们的悲欢离合、笑容与泪水，仍将会转化为孕育后代子孙的养分，开出灿烂的花朵。这是属于我们上一代人的故事，也是我们这一代人的故事，是所有在这座岛屿上奋斗的人们的—《

programme.title: 阿母第11集
programme.desc: 母亲简称母，或称妈妈，是一种亲属关系的称谓，是子女对双亲中的女性的称呼。母亲和子女是重要的直系亲属关系之一，通常具有亲密关系。一般指生育小孩的女人（即生母）；但在有些状况下，仅养育小孩（养母），或再婚配偶（继母）、结谊长辈（义母），或是仅提供卵子让精子与之结合（代孕母）（例如捐卵等辅助生殖技术），但并未亲自生育小孩的女人也可如此称呼。

programme.title: 大爱午安新闻 LIVE
programme.desc: 证严上人慈示：「新闻报导，除了『报』，还要进一步『导』，范畴要开阔，关怀普天下苍民，为时代作见证，为人类写历史。」，大爱新闻透过SNG、电话连线、数位影像，传递全球最新讯息，坚持将人间美善讯息与人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，发挥净化人心功能。

programme.title: 新何处是我家第14集
programme.desc: 萧秀珠师姊从小历经颠沛流离的童年，渴望有个家。婚后与夫婿陈松田经营塑胶袋和免洗餐具，日进斗金，但秀珠脾气却日益爆烈，亲子夫妻关系日危，再经过与生父相认却诀别，母亲坠河往生的人生起伏悲欢，终于走入慈济，毅然结束正炽的事业，投入环保志业，最后在慈济找到安身立命的地方，也找回家庭幸福！

programme.title: 仁心慧语第636集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧来自于内心，由内心启悟的智慧也最真实。证严 上人说：「做该做的事就是智慧，做不该做的事就是愚痴。」十个问题、十个解方，都是言者生命经验的体现，透过名人的智慧哲理，足以启迪人心，振聋发瞆，重新思考人生的价值。

programme.title: 人文讲堂第474集
programme.desc: 《人文讲堂》节目，邀请台湾各行各业杰出人士、学者专家，或热爱生命者，将多年的学识涵养、人文感受，以及对生命的活力，以讲演方式，直接与大众分享。讲演的内容及方式，不再流于传统，不仅是知识或专业技术而已，更会呈现出特有的人文观点。

programme.title: 乞丐许大愿第9集
programme.desc: 以捡拾回收物买卖的邹清山，一家人过著清贫的生活，在儿子邹明晃退伍后做起塑胶皮买卖，家中经济才逐渐转好。婚后邹明晃与妻子林淑靖在事业上不断努力，不仅改善家中生活，更加入慈济，捐钱捐地，在兴建大林慈院时，全家人更是全力投入协助，邹清山也从那时开始煮青草茶与人结缘。

programme.title: 乞丐许大愿第10集
programme.desc: 以捡拾回收物买卖的邹清山，一家人过著清贫的生活，在儿子邹明晃退伍后做起塑胶皮买卖，家中经济才逐渐转好。婚后邹明晃与妻子林淑靖在事业上不断努力，不仅改善家中生活，更加入慈济，捐钱捐地，在兴建大林慈院时，全家人更是全力投入协助，邹清山也从那时开始煮青草茶与人结缘。

programme.title: 行动现场第534集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 青春爱读书第319集
programme.desc: 青春爱读书 开启年轻阅读新风潮 青春爱读书，看年轻人读什么书！

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第275集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第574集

programme.title: 新霹雳英雄榜第123集
programme.desc: 《新霹雳英雄榜》是一部动作冒险类型的电视剧或电影系列，为霹雳布袋戏的新一代作品。故事背景设定在一个神秘的武林世界，充满了武术、魔法和神秘力量。故事围绕著一群英雄人物展开，他们各自拥有独特的技能和身世背景。他们将面临来自黑暗势力和邪恶组织的威胁，必须团结一致，通过战斗和冒险来守护正义和保护世界的平衡。《新霹雳英雄榜》融合了激烈的打斗场面、刺激的动作场景和细腻的角色发展，带给观众一场震撼的视觉盛宴。剧情扣人心弦，充满著惊险、奇幻和神秘的元素，同时也融入了人物之间的情感和义务的探讨。这部作品以霹雳布袋戏的独特风格和特色为基础，结合了现代特效和技术，将传统和现代元素相结合，呈现出一个全新的霹雳世界。观

programme.title: 包青天第129集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.title: 真情部落格第315集
programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: 福气人生第685集

programme.desc: 尤玛想去市集欣赏漂亮的首饰，但是哥哥尤命顾虑她的安危，严格禁止她乱跑。被限制行动的妹妹非常生气，甚至用力咬了哥哥一口，甩开哥哥跑进了森林里的山洞。尤玛和尤命进入了树人世界，而这次哥哥尤命却被魔法命中，变成了「树人」！忧心的妹妹只好担起拯救哥哥的责任，踏上异世界的惊奇之旅！为了让哥哥恢复原状，他们必须从「铁锯魔」手中拯救「花精公主」；在这趟冒险的旅程，尤玛也将深深了解哥哥对自己的爱。

programme.desc: 暗夜客话新闻是全国唯一主播、记者以全客语发音的新闻频道，并 详实显示字幕，除了著眼于「客家观点」的重要新闻议题、呈现客家生活 习俗与传统文化之外，更尽力发掘社会各阶层客家乡亲的故事。暗夜客话新闻针对四节新闻播出镜面，以桐花、蓝衫等各种不同主题的客家元素为基础，作全面的视觉设计，让收视大众们能够耳目一新、零时差的掌握，最具客家观点的新闻呈现。

programme.title: 国际新闻-客观世界第331集

programme.title: 停动停动好健康第235集
programme.desc: 《停动停动好健康》是一个关注身体健康的节目，通过介绍和推广健康的生活方式和运动方法，鼓励观众在日常生活中停下脚步，注重运动和健康饮食，增进身体健康和心灵幸福，提高生活质量。这个节目旨在激发观众对健康的关注和重视，让人们更好地照顾自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 奥林p客第1567集
programme.desc: 在新的对话中，主持人和机器人阿蓝妹将增加科技互动的元素。参赛孩子们将扮演小博士的角色，从各种主题和发明中学习现代科学和未来科技。每一集将以「一大六小」的竞赛形式进行，并引入四选一的卡牌抽选机制，让孩子们学习团队合作，并在面对不同意见时学会沟通和做出抉择。

programme.title: Bilibolo唱唱跳跳第583集
programme.desc: 为了让客语深入生活，提供一个属于小朋友的舞台，让小朋友透过表演创作来学习客语，并鼓励更多客语腔调表演，呈现出不同客语腔调文化特色，展现出客家多元腔调之美。

programme.title: 客家戏曲第709集
programme.desc: 由多个著名客家剧团，分别演出相当脍炙人口的小说故事，希望能让大家再次回味童年看戏的滋味，也能让更多人欣赏到客家的传统大戏。

programme.title: 神之器第1集
programme.desc: 客家人的祖牌，需经过木工、雕刻、油漆、书法、上金等步骤，方能放上神桌，由家族日日敬拜。上头写著历代祖先的名字，甚至在世的后代子孙之名字也在上方，蕴含著生生不息，寄托了对世代的祝福。仰望著祖牌，看见自己的爸爸妈妈祖父祖母伯公伯母叔公叔母曾祖父母都在祖牌里，而我们，也在这里。这个由几个木构件及工艺所组合的「客家祖牌」，正是客家人与家神共存交会的所在之处，也是标示我们从何而来、将归何处的象征。「神之器—回家路上」一起回家吧！

programme.title: 福气来了(南方篇)第127集
programme.desc: 《福气来了 南方篇》将延伸至中南部及花东地区，透过节目提供平台，让乡亲朋友能够走进摄影棚，分享他们的故事，并进行互相交流。在东南部的客家庄里，我们能够欣赏到独特的生活方式，美丽如画的田园风光以及多元的文化。让我们在这个地方，畅谈乡亲们的人生故事。

programme.title: 一家之煮第500集
programme.desc: 走访客庄邀请两组家庭进行对决，借由家人间的默契一起做料理，品尝彼此完成的美食，进而带领观众了解「感动人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或时令蔬果。

programme.title: 客客客栈第17集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你会联想到什么？硬颈精神、勤劳节俭、客家美食，还是满天飞舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎么来的呢？又有什么样有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 森林侦探队Ⅲ(诏安腔)第23集
programme.desc: 延续前两季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更额外增加了新的冒险伙伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面对接踵而来的森林任务，大家勇敢、热心且不畏艰难地向彼此伸出援手，尽管过程中充满挑战，却也能在每次的行动中获得意想不到的收获

programme.title: 不平凡的我们，平凡的每一天第7集

programme.title: 大自然生趣第30集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍
